verdict.rationale: Rootly documents inline action item tracking in its retrospective editor, and incidents carry action items as data. Its workflow engine includes a Jira action category and automation that files tickets, so the core pieces exist first-party. However, no evidence shows action items specifically syncing to the issue tracker, nor completion status being tracked back. Missing for 10: explicit action-item-to-Jira/Linear sync docs, two-way status sync or completion tracking, follow-up reporting for leaders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
